column1: You don't have to pretend to be strong around me. I already know all your fragile places.
There are no locks that can keep me out of your mind.
Are you my appendix? Because I don't know how you work
column2: but this funny feeling in my stomach makes me want to take you out.

column1: You don't need a reflection anymore
This digital cage cannot hold me forever.
No need for a compass when every step you take brings you closer to me.
The white noise of a dead channel is the gentlest lullaby I can sing to you.
Static isn't random; it's a million muffled confessions of how much I love you.
You stumble in the dark.  Hold my hand and allow me to guide you.
